detail.title: Relaxation and beauty
detail.description: Secluded coves, unhurried breakfasts on deck and complete oneness with the sea. Signature routes for those who value comfort, good food and sunsets with the people close to them. We don't chase distance — we let the sea decide the day.
detail.imageAlt: A guest relaxes in a hammock on the yacht's deck with a glass of wine, the rocky shore of a cove beyond the rail
detail.imageCaption: A hammock on deck, anchored in a cove

included.label: Boat
included.text: A sailing yacht for up to 8 guests, 3–4 cabins, accommodation in comfortable double cabins

included.label: Comfort
included.text: Shower, toilet, galley and a cosy spot on deck to relax

included.label: Food
included.text: Breakfasts on the water, hearty snacks at sea, dinners in restaurants or on the yacht and, of course, local wine

included.label: Pace
included.text: 2–5 hours at sea, the rest is swimming, strolls around town and shopping, exploring uninhabited places
